system.description:
• Effect: You carry a hand-built repeater that only you can work.
  • As an attack, fire it at one creature within 60ft: it makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC, taking force damage on a failure or half on a success, as a Warlock's Eldritch Blast.
  • The damage is Eldritch Blast's for your level (1d6; 1d8 at 5th, 2d6 at 9th, 2d8 at 13th, 3d6 at 17th, 3d8 at 24th) plus your Intelligence modifier.
  • It counts as a magic weapon and fires once a round even if you gain Extra Attack.
